name: Shoujo no Fushigi na Ichinichi
source:
It was the same old scenery,
and the same old routine...
...or so I thought, until...

I noticed a weird guy staring at me from behind a utility pole.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/5363]Freem![/url]]
translation:
一如既往的风景，
一如既往的日常……
……我原本是这么想的，直到……

我发现一个怪人躲在电线杆后面盯着我。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/5363]Freem![/url]]
